run_detect_layout: run detect_layout_cli to analyze document layout and detect regions like tables, images, and text blocks
run_layout_pdf: run layout detection on a PDF file to identify bounding boxes and reading order for each page
run_layout_image: run layout detection on an image file to detect document regions and their positions
run_layout_folder: run layout detection on a folder of images or PDFs to batch process document layout analysis
run_layout_page_range: run layout detection on a specific page range of a PDF document for targeted analysis
